messages:
alex (PMM): quick kickoff: we need a compact benchmark narrative for the launch post + 40-min demo. angle: tail-latency matters for UX, but cost matters for SRE budgets. can we show tradeoffs with a 3-metric panel?

riley (writer): love that angle. proposed opener: "Choose your latency curve, own your bill." 1-liner to follow: how routing + cache shifts the curve left with minimal spend.

nico (designer): thinking 3 panes in hero: left scatter (p50 vs $/1k), middle area chart (p95 over payload size), right small gauges for cache-hit %. keep palette neutral with accent for our fastpath. will make a grayscale mobile variant.

jin (analytics): numbers I can seed: baseline endpoint (stock) p50 180ms p95 420ms cost $0.12/1k. Redwood fastpath p50 70ms p95 150ms cost $0.09/1k. cached route p50 40ms p95 80ms cost $0.045/1k. cache-hit scenarios: 10% / 40% / 70% produce step improvements. I'll attach CSV.

tara (growth): CTA strategy: one CTA for devs (play with sandbox), one for infra (request dedicated demo). track with utm=tailplay + utm=tailinfra. set up two nurture tracks.

alex (PMM): copy structure: headline, micro-visual, 3 bullets: what changes, how Redwood makes it happen, how to get started. add 2-line FAQ about long payloads and quantization.

riley (writer): draft hooks for social: "Your app's worst case shouldn't define your cloud bill." and "Smart routing beats blunt force scaling." short X-friendly lines.

nico (designer): mini spec for chart (pseudo):
```
columns: [scatter, area, gauge]
scatter: x=latency_p50, y=cost_per_1k, size=throughput, color=route
area: x=payload_tokens, y=p95_latency, layers=routes
gauge: value=cache_hit_percent
```
I'll attach figma later.

jin (analytics): quick CSV snippet: `route,latency_p50,latency_p95,cost_per_1k,cache_hit`
`baseline,180,420,0.12,0`
`fastpath,70,150,0.09,0`
`cached,40,80,0.045,60`
I'll also run a sensitivity sim across payload sizes; will publish a tiny js/chart snippet for the blog.

tara (growth): inbound form asks: product use-case, scale, primary concern: latency/cost/security. route to SDR only if concern != security. also implement hidden field for flow=tail-latency.

deploybot: deploy: marketing/landing/tail-latency-hero v0.1 deployed to staging (build 1184). preview: https://staging.redwood.ai/tail-latency-hero

alex (PMM): timeline: mock + copy by tomorrow noon, analytics artifacts by EOD, growth to create forms by close. sync 20m tomorrow 11:00 to sign off. keep it tight, thanks :sparkles:
